name: QuickBooks
description: QuickBooks Online is Intuit's cloud accounting platform with a REST Accounting API.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow; no API keys or basic auth for requests. Client credentials used only to exchange the code.
gate_detail: Free Intuit developer account; Builder tier has no platform service fees. Per-developer sandbox companies provided. Paid Silver/Gold/Platinum tiers apply for higher volumes.
api_scope: REST Accounting API for customers, invoices, payments, bills, vendors, accounts and journal entries; separate Payments API; Intuit SDKs and OAuth libraries.
mcp_notes: Intuit publishes a QuickBooks connector for Claude, also called the QuickBooks app or MCP connection; no server URL given.
blocker_detail: Metered API fees apply above Builder-tier limits; some new API access requests go through Intuit support.

evidence.quote: The QuickBooks API uses OAuth 2.0 exclusively — there are no API keys or basic authentication options.
If you are a partner in the Builder tier, you won’t be subject to any Platform Service Fees
Intuit automatically provisions a sandbox QuickBooks Online company for each developer account, pre-loaded with sample data.
Use webbhooks: Reduce redundant GET requests by implementing webhook events to keep data in sync.
The QuickBooks connector for Claude (also called the QuickBooks app or MCP connection)

issues: Intuit App Partner Program fees may apply at higher volumes.
A 'New API access' support request process is mentioned but its scope is partly elided.
No independent second pass completed for this app.
